title: skills(pm-dispatch): ADR-0136 D2 becomes the triage protocol — `Journey:` line, journey bands, cross-lane product-first order, journeys feed the queue
body:
Blocked-by: #18477

Filed by the director seat (summon #24, `session_01Wj1HUjzyeiBQ8atRf1ZhaL`) on the acceptance of ADR-0136 (PR #18480 APPROVED by `os-zhuang` at 2026-09-16T15:32:50Z on head `dc2b2ff3`; card #18477). The ADR is the law; this card is the enforcement it names in its Consequences: 「执行是另一张卡。D2 三条落进 SKILL.md 分诊行与取卡全序」. ⛔ No `domain:*` set by the filer; the surface is `SKILL.md` + `core-rules.md` = `domain:skills`.

Dedup terms: `Journey: line` · `journey bands` · `cross-lane priority` · `journeys feed the queue` · `ADR-0136 enforcement`

## Deliverable — rules-layer re-keys, line-neutral (SKILL.md 812/812, core-rules 151/151), each line ≤120 B, paid in place

1. **Triage first question** (分诊座位职责, the classification lines): a triaged card carries a body-leading `Journey: JN | none` line citing `docs/adr/0136-declared-journeys-as-priority-anchor.md` D1; grading follows D2.1's bands — security/data-integrity top band regardless; journey broken/blocked ⇒ P0/P1; journey runs but produces a wrong result on its path ⇒ P2; no declared journey ⇒ p3 or `not_planned` by default, with declared-but-unenforced keys retired **per release in batches** (⛔ not one card per key).
2. **取卡全序** (执行座位职责 候选与批次): D2.2 — while any product repo (cloud / hotcrm / objectui user-facing) has an unclaimed P0/P1 carrying a `Journey:` value, no lane dispatches a p2/p3 contract-hygiene or tooling card; one sentence, cited to ADR-0136 D2.2.
3. **Queue feeding** (分诊座位职责 sweep lines): D2.3 — the journey runners (`checklist-test` / `dogfood-verification`, nightly `golden-journey.yml`, daily `scaffold-e2e.yml`, per-PR `Dogfood Regression Gate`) are the primary feed; a red journey files a card with its `Journey:` line; contract sweeps and findings become background, graded against the journey list.
4. `core-rules.md` twins re-keyed identically; `check-half-states.mjs` gains no new H-row in this PR (a `Journey:` half-state row is a follow-up only if the maintainer asks).

## Serialisation

Same file as PR #18481 (#18473) — claim after #18481 is MERGED and merge `origin/main` first; #18476 has landed its `:92` change. ⛔ Do not touch `:523` (#18434, queued).

## Acceptance

- Positive greps with controls: `Journey:` in SKILL.md ≥1 (control 0 on origin/main today); `ADR-0136` cited in the 取卡全序 block; ratchet 812/812 · 151/151; `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:skill-frame-sync` green.
- Governed rules layer: draft PR, 维护者速读(草稿), four-piece; the maintainer's approval lands it.
